features.description: dlt-mcp、llms.txt、duckdb-skills plugin を Claude Code から使えるようにする
features.evidence: 1: `bash init.sh` exit 0. 2: `uv tree --frozen | grep -c dlthub` = 0. 3: new session, `/mcp` shows `dlt` connected (human), `mcp__dlt__list_pipelines` returned [from_database, money_forward, quick_start], `mcp__dlt__search_docs(query="read_csv encoding")` returned 3 hits (file-formats/csv.md, verified-sources/filesystem/basic.md). 4: new session listed 9 duckdb-skills skills; `read-file` on a 3-row Shift_JIS sample CSV failed as non-UTF-8 with the skill's default `read_csv`, then succeeded via its fallback `read_csv(path, encoding='shift_jis')` with DuckDB CLI v2.0.1: columns 日付 DATE, 内容 VARCHAR, 金額 BIGINT, row_count 3. 5: `python3 -m json.tool` passes for .mcp.json and feature_list.json.
